detail.description: @fastify/busboy 是一个多部分表单数据解析器。在版本 1.0.0 到 3.2.0 中，可以提交多部分表单数据的攻击者可以通过发送名称为原型继承属性（例如 __proto__ 或构造函数）的部分标头来使解析器崩溃。内部标头解析器将标头存储在纯 JavaScript 对象中，并假设每个值都是一个数组，因此继承的属性名称解析为真实的非数组值并触发 TypeError。在公共管道集成中，失败表现为错误事件，但在直接写入或结束使用中，异常会同步抛出，并可能终止 Node.js 进程，从而导致未经身份验证的拒绝服务。该问题已在 @fastify/busboy 3.2.1 中修复，该版本创建具有空原型的标头对象。用户应升级到3.2.1。
detail.kind: 对因果或异常条件的不恰当检查
detail.kind_en: 对异常或特殊情况的不当检查

detail_original.description: @fastify/busboy is a multipart form-data parser. In versions 1.0.0 through 3.2.0, an attacker who can submit multipart form-data can crash the parser by sending a part header whose name is a prototype-inherited property such as __proto__ or constructor. The internal header parser stores headers in a plain JavaScript object and assumes each value is an array, so an inherited property name resolves to a truthy non-array value and triggers a TypeError. In the common pipe integration the failure surfaces as an error event, but in direct write or end usage the exception is thrown synchronously and can terminate the Node.js process, causing an unauthenticated denial of service. The issue is fixed in @fastify/busboy 3.2.1, which creates the header object with a null prototype. Users should upgrade to 3.2.1.
